verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail provides extensive AI-generated insights and suggestions from user data: Ask AI answers questions from inbox content (docs-4,18,26), Auto Labels/classification surface priorities (docs-1,46,58), Auto Drafts 2.0 pull context from inbox, calendar, and web to generate reply suggestions (docs-38,52,59), and follow-up nudges are auto-generated with drafts (docs-6,25,31). These are well-documented first-party features with rich detail across multiple product pages, though independent hands-on validation specifically of the AI insight features (vs. general product sentiment) is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically validating AI insight accuracy, and no benchmark data on suggestion quality.
